query: select p.prosrc as body, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) as arguments from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname='bobby_memory_record' and p.pronargs=4;

result.arguments: p_identity uuid, p_symbol text, p_horizon text, p_price numeric
